edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares in full by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing, without deferral or set-off. This payment obligation does not waive any claim or remedy otherwise expressly available under this Agreement. The Purchase Price, currency and any agreed pre-Closing price-adjustment mechanism shall be specified in this Agreement before execution.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing on a date agreed in writing by the parties, subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the entitled party of the closing conditions to be specified in this Agreement. The Buyer's obligation to complete shall not be subject to a financing contingency. Payment of the Purchase Price and delivery of customary share-transfer documents, to be identified and agreed before execution, shall occur concurrently.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements specifically identified in a schedule to this Agreement, including their dates and reporting periods, have been prepared in accordance with the accounting standards specified in that schedule, consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the financial position and results of operations of the issuer for the periods covered, subject to any expressly agreed qualifications for interim statements and the specific disclosures identified against this representation in the agreed disclosure schedule. The statements, standards, qualifications and disclosures must be agreed before execution.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations and procedures expressly agreed in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from breaches of the Seller's representations, warranties and covenants and from any specifically identified liabilities expressly allocated to the Seller in an agreed indemnity schedule. Before execution, the parties must agree the covered risks, treatment of disclosures, recoverable losses, exclusions, applicable caps and thresholds, survival periods, notice requirements, and procedures for direct and third-party claims, including control of defense and settlement. This clause does not create a general indemnity for all undisclosed liabilities, and no unlimited liability is agreed. The indemnity framework remains subject to client approval and completion before execution.

Please confirm the Purchase Price and currency and whether any pre-Closing price adjustment is proposed. No deferred consideration is included. The no-set-off provision preserves separately enforceable contractual claims.
